annotation.interpretation_b: The client is permitted to discard the response data upon receiving a cancellation signal.
annotation.justification: The use of 'MAY' creates ambiguity because it doesn't specify whether ignoring the cancellation is the preferred behavior or simply an allowed one. This impacts how a client would implement the cancellation handling.
annotation.missing_information: The conditions under which the client *should* ignore the cancellation are not specified. A missing constraint on whether the client is expected to ignore the cancellation, or whether it is merely permitted to do so, affects implementation.
